103:     mutating func adopt(_ result: ProjectLibrary?, for request: ProjectLibraryRequest,
104:                         currentProjectID: UUID?, currentScene: LightingScene) throws -> ProjectLibraryAdoption? {
105:         guard pending?.id == request.id, generation == request.generation,
106:               currentProjectID == request.projectID else { return nil }
107: 
108:         let adoption: ProjectLibraryAdoption
109:         switch request.operation {
110:         case .load:
111:             let active = result?.activeProject
112:             if result != nil && active == nil { throw ProjectLibraryError.invalidLibrary }
113:             adoption = .init(library: result, scene: active?.scene ?? request.scene, saved: active?.scene,
114:                              resetsHistory: true, resetsPresentation: false)
115:         case .save:
116:             guard let active = result?.activeProject else { throw ProjectLibraryError.invalidLibrary }
117:             // Even if a future caller allows edits during save, never mark its
118:             // newer current scene as written or replace it with the old scene.
119:             adoption = .init(library: result, scene: currentScene, saved: active.scene,
120:                              resetsHistory: false, resetsPresentation: false)
121:         case .change:
122:             guard let active = result?.activeProject else { throw ProjectLibraryError.invalidLibrary }
123:             let switching = active.id != request.projectID
124:             adoption = .init(library: result, scene: switching ? active.scene : currentScene,
125:                              saved: active.scene, resetsHistory: switching, resetsPresentation: switching)
126:         case .reload, .recover:
127:             guard let active = result?.activeProject else { throw ProjectLibraryError.invalidLibrary }
128:             adoption = .init(library: result, scene: active.scene, saved: active.scene,
129:                              resetsHistory: true, resetsPresentation: true)
130:         }
131:         // First save changes draft identity, but deliberately keeps history,
132:         // selection and mode. Reloading the same ID still invalidates old views.
133:         if adoption.resetsHistory || result?.activeID != request.projectID { generation = UUID() }
134:         finish(request)
135:         return adoption
136:     }

132:     func testFirstSaveKeepsSelectionAndHistoryAndReleasesTask() async throws {
133:         let base = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
134:         defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: base) }
135:         let session = StudioSession(store: ProjectStore(applicationSupportDirectory: base, arguments: [], environment: [:]))
136:         try await open(session)
137:         let original = session.scene
138:         session.select(original.lights[2].id, from: session.generation)
139:         var edited = original
140:         edited.lights[0].candela = 1500
141:         session.replace(edited, from: session.generation)
142:         let reset = session.workspaceResetID
143:         let controlOwner = session.editOwner("camera.position")
144:         let generation = session.generation
145:         try await session.beginLibraryOperation(.save, from: generation).value
146:         XCTAssertEqual(session.saved, edited)
147:         XCTAssertEqual(session.selection, original.lights[2].id)
148:         XCTAssertNotEqual(session.generation, generation)
149:         XCTAssertEqual(session.workspaceResetID, reset)
150:         XCTAssertEqual(session.editOwner("camera.position"), controlOwner)
151:         XCTAssertNil(session.operationTask)
152:         XCTAssertFalse(session.isBusy)
153:         XCTAssertTrue(session.undo(from: session.generation))
154:         XCTAssertEqual(session.scene, original)
155:         XCTAssertEqual(session.editOwner("camera.position"), controlOwner)
156:         XCTAssertNotEqual(session.saved, session.scene)
157:     }

358:         XCTAssertEqual(session.generation, generation)

363:         XCTAssertNotEqual(session.generation, generation)

365:         XCTAssertNotEqual(session.editOwner("camera.position"), controlOwner)
366:         XCTAssertFalse(session.history.canUndo)
367:         XCTAssertEqual(session.selection, session.scene.lights.first?.id)

369:     }
